import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { ExportImportDataService, ImportPO, SupplierBid } from '../../services/export-import-data.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-import-management', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `
Keya Raw Material Imports

Import Purchase Orders & LC Lifecycle Desk

Manage raw cotton imports, open LCs, track vessel ETA, and evaluate competitive supplier bids.

REVERSE TENDER ENGINE

Live Supplier Bids Submitted for Keya Procurement Tenders

{{ dataService.supplierBids().length }} Bids Received
@for (bid of dataService.supplierBids(); track bid.id) { }
Bid Code Tender Code Supplier Company Offered Unit Price Lead Time Proposal Details Status Action
{{ bid.bidCode }} {{ bid.tenderCode }} {{ bid.supplierCompanyName }}
{{ bid.contactEmail }}
 {{ dataService.formatValue(bid.offeredUnitPriceUSD) }} / Unit {{ bid.deliveryLeadTimeDays }} Days {{ bid.proposalDetails }} {{ bid.status }}

Active Import Purchase Orders & LCs

@for (po of dataService.importPOs(); track po.poNumber) { }
PO Number LC Number Supplier Name Raw Material Item Quantity Total Value Expected Arrival Status
{{ po.poNumber }} {{ po.lcNumber }} {{ po.supplierName }} {{ po.productName }} {{ po.quantity }} {{ po.unit }} {{ dataService.formatValue(po.totalValueUSD) }} {{ po.expectedArrival }} {{ po.status }}
` }) export class ImportManagementComponent { dataService = inject(ExportImportDataService); showNewPoModal = signal(false); acceptSupplierBid(bid: SupplierBid) { bid.status = 'Accepted'; const newPo: ImportPO = { poNumber: `PO-IMP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`, piNumber: `PI-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`, lcNumber: `LC-HSBC-2026-${Date.now().toString().slice(-3)}`, supplierName: bid.supplierCompanyName, productName: 'Raw Cotton Bales (From Supplier Bid)', quantity: 500, unit: 'MT', unitPriceUSD: bid.offeredUnitPriceUSD, totalValueUSD: bid.offeredUnitPriceUSD * 500000, currency: 'USD', expectedArrival: '2026-10-10', status: 'LC Opened' }; this.dataService.importPOs.update(list => [newPo, ...list]); alert(`Import Desk: Bid ${bid.bidCode} Accepted! Issued Import PO ${newPo.poNumber} and opened LC with ${bid.supplierCompanyName}.`); } }
